title: Played pawn feel, blind A/B (DPC 0.9.177-dev6)
intro: About 5 minutes. Three parts (melee, mage, archer), each played twice: one round has the new input fix, one doesn't (not shown). Note which round felt better each time.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return s and s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.job: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return s and s.active and s.pawn_job or 0
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_prev_state ~= false
probes.pf: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pipfix_n or 0
probes.dpc_cancels: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cancel_n or 0
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.trg: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok, v = pcall(function() return s.pawn_input:get_field('ButtonTriggerFlags') end); return ok and v or 0

steps.text: Starting
PART 1 MELEE: play the Fighter (or any melee pawn) yourself. A few enemies help. Press End when you're in control.
MELEE ROUND 1 of 2. Light combos, light into heavy, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard. Mash early to test buffering. Press End to start (40 s).
ROUND 1: Light combos, light into heavy, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard. Mash early to test buffering.
MELEE ROUND 2 of 2: the same again. Remember which round felt better. Press End (40 s).
ROUND 2: Light combos, light into heavy, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard. Mash early to test buffering.
Which round felt better, 1 or 2 (or same)? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
PART 2 MAGE: switch to the Mage / Sorcerer pawn. Press End when you're in control.
MAGE ROUND 1 of 2. Start spells and press L2 mid-chant to cancel; also cast fully; also cancel into another spell or a dodge. Press End to start (40 s).
ROUND 1: Start spells and press L2 mid-chant to cancel; also cast fully; also cancel into another spell or a dodge.
MAGE ROUND 2 of 2: the same again. Remember which round felt better. Press End (40 s).
ROUND 2: Start spells and press L2 mid-chant to cancel; also cast fully; also cancel into another spell or a dodge.
Which round felt better, 1 or 2 (or same)? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
PART 3 ARCHER: switch to the Archer pawn. Press End when you're in control.
ARCHER ROUND 1 of 2. Shots from the hip and aimed, skills from the hip and aimed, dodge out of aim. Press End to start (35 s).
ROUND 1: Shots from the hip and aimed, skills from the hip and aimed, dodge out of aim.
ARCHER ROUND 2 of 2: the same again. Remember which round felt better. Press End (35 s).
ROUND 2: Shots from the hip and aimed, skills from the hip and aimed, dodge out of aim.
Which round felt better, 1 or 2 (or same)? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
Done: fix back on. Tell Claude your picks (melee / mage / archer).
